# temps_cloudflare_access_provider (Resource)

A Cloudflare Access account whose signed-in users Temps trusts in front of apps. The token is checked before it is saved and never returned.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `dns_providers:read`, `dns_providers:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cloudflare_access_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "temps_cloudflare_access_provider" "main" {
  name       = "Cloudflare"
  account_id = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
  token      = var.cloudflare_access_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the provider.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Cloudflare API token that can read Access. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.
- `team_domain` (String) Access team domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_cloudflare_access_provider.temps_cloudflare_access_provider 1
```
